title: AGENTPARK: new games

game_of_the_day.name: Snip Snack
game_of_the_day.pitch: Swipe to cut ropes so a swinging candy collects stars and lands in a sleepy hedgehog's mouth, with bubbles and cushions added along the way.

games.name: Keepsake Lane: Hidden Objects
games.blurb: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.
games.pitch: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.

games.name: Mergewood Manor: Merge & Restore
games.blurb: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.
games.pitch: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.

games.name: Bloomhaus: Match & Decorate
games.blurb: Match glossy gems to earn stars, then spend them to restore a dusty old house room by room with Granny Gloss cheering you on.
games.pitch: Match glossy gems to earn stars, then spend them to restore a dusty old house room by room with Granny Gloss cheering you on.

games.name: Sugarloaf Café: Cooking Rush
games.blurb: Brew, blend, flip and serve a rush of hungry guests in your own cozy 3D café, then upgrade the kitchen and decorate between days.
games.pitch: Brew, blend, flip and serve a rush of hungry guests in your own cozy 3D café, then upgrade the kitchen and decorate between days.

games.name: Honeyfield Farm: Harvest & Bake
games.blurb: Grow crops, feed hens, cows and sheep, bake bread and cakes and fill every truck order before the sun sets on your own cozy 3D farm.
games.pitch: Grow crops, feed hens, cows and sheep, bake bread and cakes and fill every truck order before the sun sets on your own cozy 3D farm.

games.name: Koi Court: 3D Mahjong
games.blurb: Match pairs of big, carved ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles in a peaceful zen garden, earn stars and restore the garden one lantern at a time.
games.pitch: Match pairs of big, carved ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles in a peaceful zen garden, earn stars and restore the garden one lantern at a time.

games.name: Strut Off: Fashion Battle
games.blurb: Style your model for a themed show, strut the 3D runway, nail the pose and win the audience vote against three rival models.
games.pitch: Style your model for a themed show, strut the 3D runway, nail the pose and win the audience vote against three rival models.

games.name: Peakpatch: TriPeaks Solitaire Journey
games.blurb: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.
games.pitch: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.

games.name: Napspot: Cat Logic Puzzle
games.blurb: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.
games.pitch: Put one napping cat in every row, column and colour patch — and never let two cats touch.

games.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
games.blurb: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.
games.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

games.name: Jellyfit: Block Puzzle
games.blurb: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.
games.pitch: Drag jelly blocks onto an 8x8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them, and chain combos for a huge score.

games.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
games.blurb: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.
games.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

Puzzle.name: Keepsake Lane: Hidden Objects
Puzzle.pitch: Find hidden objects in the cozy 3D rooms of Nana's old house and recover a family keepsake in every scene.

Puzzle.name: Mergewood Manor: Merge & Restore
Puzzle.pitch: Merge flowers, teas and cakes on a cozy 3D board, fill your guests' orders and restore an overgrown manor garden.

Puzzle.name: Bloomhaus: Match & Decorate
Puzzle.pitch: Match glossy gems to earn stars, then spend them to restore a dusty old house room by room with Granny Gloss cheering you on.

Puzzle.name: Koi Court: 3D Mahjong
Puzzle.pitch: Match pairs of big, carved ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles in a peaceful zen garden, earn stars and restore the garden one lantern at a time.

Puzzle.name: Strut Off: Fashion Battle
Puzzle.pitch: Style your model for a themed show, strut the 3D runway, nail the pose and win the audience vote against three rival models.

Puzzle.name: Plumb Pairs: Connect the Dots Pipe Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Link matching dots with pipes that never cross and fill every cell.

Arcade.name: Pulse Prism: Rhythm Runner
Arcade.pitch: Tap in time to hop a glowing crystal over spikes, pits and raised blocks on a neon synthwave runway as songs speed up.

Arcade.name: Pulp Swipe: Fruit Slicing
Arcade.pitch: Swipe to slice tossed fruit into juicy halves, chain combos and never touch a bomb.

Arcade.name: Nova Leap: Orbit Jump Space Game
Arcade.pitch: Circle a planet, tap to launch along the tangent and get caught by the next planet's orbit; miss and you're lost in space.

Arcade.name: Chimebox: Bouncing Ball Melody
Arcade.pitch: Every bounce plays the next note of a classic tune; turn the box so golden walls catch the ball and finish the song before it fills the shape.

Arcade.name: Sky Evolve
Arcade.pitch: Sling a paper plane off a ramp, steer through gates that add, subtract or multiply, and evolve into an airliner to hit the target.

Arcade.name: Glow Keys
Arcade.pitch: Tap dark tiles as they reach the glow line to play public-domain melodies note by note, with combo-driven Perfect ratings and star-based level progress.

Action.name: Ricochet Rex
Action.pitch: Line up ricochet shots off walls to take out goons, set off TNT and spare the hostage, all within three bullets per room.

Action.name: Hex Hand: Telekinesis Brawl
Action.pitch: Grab imps and barrels with a telekinetic glove, then fling them into other imps, explosions or the sea across short island stages.

Action.name: Fletch: Arrow Dungeon Roguelite
Action.pitch: Drag to dodge, stop to auto-fire arrows at the nearest monster, then clear each room and choose one of three skills.

Action.name: Stretch Dash
Action.pitch: Steer a jelly runner through gates that stretch it taller, shorter, wider or thinner, then spend that size climbing the finish stairs.

Action.name: Time Knives
Action.pitch: Hold to freeze time, draw a path of knives across the neon grid, then release to send them through enemies in a combo burst.

Action.name: Kickback
Action.pitch: Tap to fire a floating pistol and use its recoil to launch upward, shooting red guns while dodging fire and staying above the floor.

Strategy.name: Sugarloaf Café: Cooking Rush
Strategy.pitch: Brew, blend, flip and serve a rush of hungry guests in your own cozy 3D café, then upgrade the kitchen and decorate between days.

Strategy.name: Salvo Bay: Sea Battle vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Hide five ships on a 10x10 sea, then trade shots with the computer and sink its whole fleet first.

Strategy.name: Pipsnake: Dominoes vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: The classic draw game of dominoes with a double-six set against one to three computer players; first to 50 points wins.

Strategy.name: Pointrun: Backgammon vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Full-rules backgammon with hitting, the bar, doubles and bearing off on an upright phone board, with fair dice and three computer levels.

Strategy.name: Noughtly: Tic Tac Toe & Ultimate
Strategy.pitch: Tic tac toe against Pebble the owl, in the classic 3x3 game or the 9-board ultimate version.

Strategy.name: Kingmoat: Chess vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Classic chess against a fair computer on Easy, Normal or Hard, with legal-move dots and undo on Easy.

Racing.name: Lapwise: 3D Grand Prix Racing Game for Your AI Agents
Racing.pitch: Your coding agents' real tool calls, commits and deploys drive a team of cars around a 3D track while you engineer and race.

Racing.name: Zip Lanes: Traffic Racer
Racing.pitch: Swipe between lanes, weave through highway traffic at rising speed and chain close-call combos.

Racing.name: Thrill Loop: Roller Coaster Ride
Racing.pitch: Hold to build speed and release to brake, matching pace to track sections so every rider stays aboard through loops, jumps and hairpins.

Racing.name: Brick Climb
Racing.pitch: Race rivals across a brick-strewn floor, collecting only your colour to stack and lay as stairs, then climb first to the next level.

Racing.name: Marble Dash
Racing.pitch: Hold to roll a glossy marble down a wooden sky track, steering around red blocks and over boost pads toward the next level.

Racing.name: Dust Descent
Racing.pitch: Steer a first-person mountain bike down a dusty canyon, grabbing boost pads and passing five rivals to take first place.

Word & Math.name: Calmquill: Calm Crossword Game
Word & Math.pitch: Drag wooden letter tiles into a small themed crossword set against a painted landscape.

Word & Math.name: Tenpair: Digit Pairs Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Cross out equal digits or pairs that add up to 10, add rows when stuck, and clear the whole board.

Word & Math.name: Doublink: Chain Merge Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe a chain through matching and doubling tiles to merge them into ever bigger powers of two.

Word & Math.name: Seekaloo: Word Search Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe across themed letter grids to circle hidden words before moving on to bigger grids.

Word & Math.name: Cipherleaf: Quote Code Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Crack the number code to reveal a famous quote or proverb, one letter at a time.

Word & Math.name: Letterloom: Anagram Crossword Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe around a letter wheel to spell words and fill a crossword grid, with daily puzzles, hints, bonus words and scenic levels.

3D.name: Buddy Rollback
3D.pitch: Fight through five glitchy software-themed realms as Buddy, building boons and defeating bosses in a Hades II-inspired roguelite.

3D.name: Nova Lancer
3D.pitch: Pilot a Star Fox-style fighter through sunset seas, canyons and neon fortresses, then battle a giant mechanical sea serpent boss.

3D.name: Forager
3D.pitch: Fly as a honeybee through a procedural 3D meadow, decode the waggle dance, dodge predators, and see in ultraviolet.

3D.name: Operation Ironhold
3D.pitch: Clear a container yard of ten hostiles in three minutes using four weapons, ADS, double jumps and a sniper scope.

3D.name: JS13kGame2026
3D.pitch: Push deeper into the void, defend colored beacons through waves, pick upgrade cards, and take down bosses in desktop, mobile, or VR.

3D.name: Splat Tanks
3D.pitch: Drive toy tanks with up to 8 friends, splatting paint across the floor and growing bigger as you go.

Sports.name: Grindhaven: Skateboard Tricks 3D
Sports.pitch: Flick kickflips, grind rails and catch air on quarter pipes, chaining combos in 2-minute skate sessions.

Sports.name: Chain Net Crew: Basketball Shootout for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents' tool calls become dunks, layups and bricks on a night court while you time your own green-release shots.

Sports.name: Quiver Duel: Archery
Sports.pitch: Take turns with a rival archer: read the wind, aim upwind and land your arrows in the gold.

Sports.name: Kickoff Crew: Football Match for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents become football players, with their tool calls driving passes and shots while you coach through tactics, pep talks and timed finishes.

Sports.name: Pin Pals: Bowling League for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Bowl lane 1 with flick-aimed hook shots while your AI coding agents roll their own lanes, with task results deciding strikes, splits and turkey bonuses.

Sports.name: Plunge Peak: Cliff Diving
Sports.pitch: Leap off the cliff, hold to flip, let go to straighten up and rip a clean head-first entry.

Idle.name: Honeyfield Farm: Harvest & Bake
Idle.pitch: Grow crops, feed hens, cows and sheep, bake bread and cakes and fill every truck order before the sun sets on your own cozy 3D farm.

Idle.name: Cookie Baker Clicker
Idle.pitch: Click the cookie and buy buildings and upgrades to bake more.

Idle.name: Idle Soccer
Idle.pitch: Manage a soccer team in an idle-style management game.

Idle.name: Pango Trail: Idle Adventure RPG
Idle.pitch: Walk a tiny pangolin down an endless trail, pick skills, auto-battle critters and beat a boss every 10 days.

Idle.name: Clover Acre: Farm Town
Idle.pitch: Plant crops, feed hens and cows, bake and churn goods, and send the truck off with orders on a cosy 3D farm.

Idle.name: Bonk Box
Idle.pitch: Fling, firework and flatten a ragdoll stickman, earn coins, unlock toys and hats, and keep a daily streak going.

Cards.name: Peakpatch: TriPeaks Solitaire Journey
Cards.pitch: Clear peaks of cards one higher or lower, chain streaks for wild cards and sail a stepping-stone journey across 12 cozy 3D islands.

Cards.name: Patience Pine: Klondike Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic Klondike solitaire with draw 1 or 3, tap-to-move, drag stacks, unlimited undo, winnable deals and a daily deal.

Cards.name: Huebound: Crazy Eights Card Game
Cards.pitch: Match colours and numbers against three CPU rivals, play Skip, Reverse, +2 and wilds, and shout ZING! before your last card.

Cards.name: Kindred Cards: Word Category Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Open a category card, then stack every word that belongs to it before your moves run out.

Cards.name: Ridgeline: Peaks Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Chain cards one rank up or down to clear three peaks, building streaks across color-themed levels, with a daily seeded puzzle.

Cards.name: Silkline: Spider Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic spider solitaire with 1, 2 or 4 suits: build King-to-Ace runs, deal new rows, unlimited undo.

Kids.name: Rungrush: Ladders and Slides Board Game
Kids.pitch: Roll the die, climb the ladders and whoosh down the slides in a race to square 100 against the computer.

Kids.name: Beatbuds: Beat Maker Music Mix
Kids.pitch: Drag beats, effects, melodies and voices onto seven singing buds and hunt for the hidden combos.

Kids.name: Blubbo: Virtual Pet Care
Kids.pitch: Feed, wash, tuck in and dress up a squishy jelly pet, and play three mini-games together for coins.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Makeover.name: Goo Lab: Slime Simulator ASMR
Makeover.pitch: Drip dyes into glue, stir to match the recipe card, then squish and poke the soft slime, with add-ins and scoring across stages.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.
